'''Red Squadron''', also known as '''Red Flight''', '''Red Squad''', '''Red Group''', or '''Red Wing''', was an [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Their unit specialties included starfighter dogfighting, convoy raids, convoy escort missions, planetary strafing and bombing runs, and capital ship harassments. Although Red Squadron primarily flew [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] on their missions, they relied on the [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighters]] for missions relating to heavy bombardment.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The squadron most famously fought at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> By the time of the Battle of Yavin, [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] had made Red Squadron a floating unit that could be reassigned at will, largely because of a growing list of successes in anti-Imperial missions&mdash;enough that the Empire listed them, and especially the key personnel, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], as active threats in their official field manual, the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==History==
===Aboard ''Independence''===
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] Red Squadron was stationed aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], flying [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]],<ref name="XW" /> and [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter]]s<ref name="NEGC" /> during the [[Battle of Turkana]], [[Operation Strike Fear]], and the [[Operation Skyhook|buildup]] to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] who flew with the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] included [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hamo Blastwell]], [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], [[Samuel Raider]] and [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]]. Along with [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadrons]], the unit's personnel were transferred to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] and reassigned to different squadrons for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] assault, while the squadron's ranks were bolstered by a group of experienced pilots including<ref name="XWOSG" /> Red Squadron veteran Lieutenant<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="XWOSG" />

===Yavin Base===
[[File:SWEMPDTPB-FC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Members of Red Squadron's new roster]]
While ''Independence'' transfers Keyan Farlander<ref name="XWOSG" /> and Puck Naeco remained with the squadron, [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] cobbled together a new roster of pilots: [[Theron Nett/Legends|Theron Nett]] from Dreis' old command the [[Dantooine Squadron]], [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]] Wedge Antilles, [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], and [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mutineers [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] of the mock unit [[Ecliptic Evaders]], third and fourth [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] [[Flight leader/Legends|leaders]] [[Wenton Chan/Legends|Wenton Chan]] and [[Elyhek Rue/Legends|Elyhek Rue]] from the [[Griffon Flight Wing]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] political scientist<ref name="XW.5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> [[Cesi Eirriss|Cesi "Doc" Eirriss]], and Alliance veteran [[Jal Te Gniev]].<ref name="TEGW" />

[[File:XWRS0-point-5-FC.png|thumb|right|200px|Red Squadron ambushed over Commenor]]
However, the new Red Squadron, also called "Red Flight,"<ref name="ANHr">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref> saw its first casualties before the mission for which it was formed.<ref name="TEGW" /> Following a scouting mission from the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost|Rebel base]] on [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]], Janson contracted [[Hesken Fever]], and was replaced by his friend and fellow Yellow Ace Lieutenant<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]], flying as [[Red Six/Legends|Red Six]].<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> In the days prior to the Battle of Yavin, Porkins joined [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]] Wedge Antilles, [[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]] Biggs Darklighter, and [[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]] Doc Eirriss for a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission]] to acquire [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nera Dantels]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. Following a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and an altercation with a group of extortionate locals, the Red Squadron X-wing pilots made contact with Captain Dantels, and were escorting her [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] the ''[[Starduster]]'' offworld&mdash;with its cargo of [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-]] and [[R5-series astromech droid]]s&mdash;when they were set upon by twelve [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] from an [[Folor Base (Imperial)|Imperial base]] on Commenor's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Folor]]. In the ensuing [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], the Rebels quickly destroyed several TIE fighters, the wreckage of one of which struck Doc Eirriss' X-wing, disabling her [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Before Eirriss could be transferred to the ''Starduster'', TIE reinforcements arrived, forcing Red Squadron to leave without Doc, who drove her ship into the enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] to buy time for the squadron to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Returning to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to deliver the droids, the pilots swore to destroy the Death Star in Eirriss' memory before being introduced to new squadron member [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="XW.5" /> A childhood friend of Biggs Darklighter's from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Skywalker served as [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]] and the leader of Red Squadron's second flight, taking the place of Hobbie Klivian,<ref name="TEGW" /> who had been sidelined by the loss of his [[Limb/Legends|leg]] and resulting infection in a [[strike at an Incom Corporation facility]].<ref name="E12">[[Empire 12|''Empire'' 12]]</ref> Doc's replacement as Red Four was [[John D. Branon/Legends|John D. Branon]], a young Tierfon Yellow Ace recommended by Jek Porkins for his bravery. Jal Te Gniev, confined to sickbay with the [[measles]],<ref name="VQ1">[[Vader's Quest 1|''Vader's Quest'' 1]]</ref> had his position filled by [[Bren Quersey/Legends|Bren Quersey]], a Dantooine Squadron pilot trained by Wedge Antilles who flew as [[Red Eight/Legends|Red Eight]].<ref name="TEGW" />

===Battle of Yavin===
{{Quote|All wings report in. &mdash; Red Ten standing by. &mdash; Red Seven standing by. &mdash; Red Three standing by. &mdash; Red Six standing by. &mdash; Red Nine standing by. &mdash; Red Two standing by. &mdash; Red Eleven standing by. &mdash; Red Five standing by.|Red Squadron at the Battle of Yavin|audio=RedSquadronRollCall.flac|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:XwingpilotredsquadronTCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Red Squadron pilot at the Battle of Yavin]]
Upon his arrival at Yavin Base in the smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] freighter the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Luke Skywalker brought with him the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] carried within the astromech droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], from which the Alliance hoped to discover a weakness which would allow them to destroy the immense [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="ANH" /> As the data was analyzed, the Death Star was detected in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. With their base temporarily shielded by the planet [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], three Red Squadron X-wings were joined by a pair of Blue Squadron<ref name="XW" /> R-22 Spearheads in a preliminary attack on the Death Star's defenses, hoping to destroy its [[communications satellite]], disrupting Imperial operations and preventing them from calling for reinforcements. Although two of the X-wings were shot down, the third, flown by now-Captain Keyan Farlander, ignored the [[TIE series/Legends|enemy fighters]] and successfully destroyed the comm sat, while his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] were later rescued.<ref name="XWOSG" />

[[File:Yavin_base_briefing_room.jpg|thumb|right|250px|General Dodonna briefs the Rebellion's pilots for the Death Star assault.]]
Analysis of the plans revealed a vulnerability in the Death Star's defense, and in a meeting led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], Red Squadron's pilots were briefed on the coming mission: the Rebel fighters would maneuver through a [[Meridian trench/Legends|trench]] on the station's surface before reaching a two-meter-wide [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]]. A precise [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] hit down the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] exhaust port shaft would trigger a chain reaction in the Death Star's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] system, destroying the space station. While Wedge Antilles decried the shot as impossible, Skywalker was more optimistic, likening it to his hunting of [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] in a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] on Tatooine.<ref name="ANH" /> To prepare for the trench run, Captain Farlander and his flight leader set out to clear the Death Star's surface defenses by taking out several [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|batteries]] marked by a [[Navigation buoy/Legends|nav buoy]] and destroying four [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] ports, limiting the Death Star's ability to launch TIE fighters. Upon his return to Yavin Base, Farlander was transferred to Gold Squadron,<ref name="XWOSG" /> a Y-wing unit tasked with the initial run on the Death Star exhaust port.<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:Battle_of_Yavin.png|thumb|left|250px|Rebel forces at the Battle of Yavin]]
With the Death Star minutes away from firing range of Yavin 4, the final assault on the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]-equipped [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] began. As Red Squadron's twelve X-wings<ref name="FF1">{{FactFile2013|1|YAV 1-4|The Battle of Yavin}}</ref> made their approach, Red Leader Garven Dreis observed that Red Two Wedge Antilles was out of position and ordered him to return. Correcting the offending error in his ranger by switching to manual control, Antilles closed formation.<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> Standing by for combat, Dreis had the pilots under his command report in, lock their [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] into attack position, and set their [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] to double front. Passing through the space station's [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]], Antilles was struck by its immense size, remarking on it aloud before being reprimanded by Dreis. Giving the order to accelerate to attack speed, he led his pilots across the Death Star's axis, drawing fire from the station's guns away from Gold Squadron as the Y-wings prepared for the battle's first trench run.<ref name="ANH" />

Diving towards the Death Star while strafing its surface, Red Five Luke Skywalker passed through an explosion on his path, receiving only superficial damage to his starfighter. Red Three Biggs Darklighter, with Red Six Jek Porkins as cover, targeted a [[deflection tower]], and while Darklighter successfully destroyed the tower,<ref name="ANH" /> Porkins' X-wing was struck by its debris. Due to the resulting failures in his flight control systems,<ref name="CCGIGAPH">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=I've Got A Problem Here}}</ref> Porkins was an easy target for the Death Star's [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]. Darklighter warned his squadron mate first to eject, and then to pull up, but despite his assurances, Porkins' fighter was struck by turbolaser fire and he was killed in its explosion.<ref name="ANHn" /> With Antilles and Darklighter on his wing, Skywalker destroyed a further ten deflection towers.<ref name="RS2">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

[[File:Yavin_dogfight.png|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker comes to his old friend Biggs Darklighter's aid.]]
As the small size of the Rebel snubfighters allowed them to evade the Death Star's turbolasers, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] scrambled part of the station's complement of TIE fighters to engage the Rebels ship-to-ship, while Vader pursued Gold Squadron in his [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]].<ref name="FF1" /> Picking up new signals that indicated the arrival of the Imperial fighters, Yavin Base warned the squadron leaders of the threat. While initially unable to detect the fighters on their scopes, Red Squadron's pilots caught sight of the incoming TIEs, one of which was quickly shot down by Red Four John D. Branon&mdash;though Branon was himself hit and killed shortly after. Another [[TIE pilot]] targeted Biggs Darklighter's X-wing, but was eliminated by Luke Skywalker. Despite Garven Dreis' order to tighten formation in response to heavy fire and interference, Skywalker broke off for an attack run on a [[lateral stabilizer]] protruding from the Death Star's surface. Destroying the stabilizer, Skywalker continued on to another, but was forced to abandon his second target due to the pursuing [[DS-61-4]], who struck the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot's]] X-wing with laser fire.<ref name="CCGB4">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Black 4}}</ref> Unable to outmaneuver his opponent, Skywalker was rescued by Wedge Antilles' precise gunnery, destroying his persistent foe.<ref name="ANHn" /> Although the Rebels saw some success against the TIE Fighters&mdash;Antilles was credited with a half dozen kills during the assault,<ref name="GG1">[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope'', Second Edition]]</ref> while Red Eight Bren Quersey scored a hit<ref name="CCGR8">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Red 8}}</ref> on Vader's wingman [[Mithel/Legends|"Mauler" Mithel]]<ref name="CCGDS2">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=DS-61-2}}</ref>&mdash;the Imperial craft overwhelmed them with sheer numbers.<ref name="FF1" />

[[File:Xwings_trenchrun.png|thumb|left|250px|Red Squadron makes its ill-fated first trench run.]]
In the meridian trench, Gold Squadron's run at the Death Star exhaust port had been cut short by the arrival of Darth Vader and his wingmen. With the Y-wing squadron all but wiped out, [[Gold Five/Legends|Gold Five]] [[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]]<ref name="FF1" /> commed his old friend Garven Dreis, passing responsibility for the trench run onto the X-wing squadron before succumbing to Imperial laser fire. Gathering his composure, Dreis ordered his six surviving pilots to rendezvous at mark six point one and report in. Pursuing Luke Skywalker on his way to the rendezvous point, an Imperial pilot was surprised and shot down by Biggs Darklighter.<ref name="ANHn" /> Advised by General Dodonna to split his Red Squadron in two, keeping half his group out of range as he began a second trench run, Dreis ordered Skywalker to take Darklighter and Antilles and hold position until he gave the signal to start their run. With his long-time wingman<ref name="TEGW" /> [[Red Ten/Legends|Red Ten]] Theron Nett and [[Red Twelve/Legends|Red Twelve]] Puck Naeco behind him, Dreis entered the trench.<ref name="FF1" /> Struggling to make out the exhaust port or the Imperial fighters, Nett had Skywalker scan for the enemy ships, with the young Rebel catching sight of Vader and his wingmen coming in at point three five just as Dreis came in range of the target. While his wingmen fell to Vader and [[DS-61-3]] "Backstabber,"<ref name="CCGDS3">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=DS-61-3}}</ref> Red Leader activated his [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] and fired a pair of proton torpedoes at the exhaust port. Initial Rebel celebration at the hit ended abruptly as Dreis realized the shot had merely impacted on the surface. Rising from the trench with Vader on his tail, the squadron leader declined Skywalker's offer of cover, instead ordering the three remaining craft to prepare for a third run as he lost his upper<ref name="ANHn" /> starboard [[Engine/Legends|engine]] to his pursuer's lasers, plummeting to his death on the Death Star's surface.<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:FarlanderYavin-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Surviving Red Squadron veterans return to Yavin 4.]]
Luke Skywalker ordered his wingmen to close formation and enter the trench at full throttle, assuaging Biggs Darklighter's concern that their speed was too high to safely pull out by comparing the meridian trench to [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] on Tatooine, where Darklighter had skimmed the canyon walls by millimeters as he rose from a womp rat hunt.<ref name="SW17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref> Dodging turbolaser fire, the three Rebel craft dove into the trench with Darklighter and Antilles falling behind Skywalker to provide him cover. Wedge Antilles, skeptical of the targeting computer's ability to hit the exhaust port and concerned by a defensive tower and the far end of the trench,<ref name="ANHn" /> was instructed to focus on the Imperial fighters by Skywalker, who had his onboard astromech R2-D2 attempt to repair a malfunctioning [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]]. As Darth Vader and his wingmen approached at point three, TIE pilot "Backstabber" scored a hit on Antilles' X-wing, destroying his micro-maneuvering controls<ref name="CCGR2">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Red 2}}</ref> and forcing him to pull out of the trench run. Letting Antilles go, Vader accelerated in pursuit of Skywalker, firing on and killing Darklighter in the process, leaving Red Squadron's newest member without cover as he prepared his targeting computer for the final assault on the exhaust port. With the voice of his fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] mentor [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] advising him to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker shut off his computer to the distress of the Yavin Base command below. Insisting that he was alright, the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] pilot continued on towards his target, even as Vader's lasers struck R2-D2, disabling his faithful droid. With the Death Star closing to firing range and preparing to destroy Yavin 4, Vader's TIE Advanced caught up with Skywalker's X-wing only to be ambushed by the returning ''Millennium Falcon''. Experiencing a change of heart on his decision to flee rather than fight for the Rebellion, Han Solo shot down "Backstabber" and caused "Mauler" Mithel to careen into Vader's TIE, killing Mithel and sending Vader spinning off into space. Finally clear, Luke Skywalker launched his proton torpedoes, which, guided by the Force, struck the exhaust port perfectly, destroying the Death Star and saving Yavin 4. Regrouping with the ''Falcon'', Antilles, and Keyan Farlander, the lone survivor of Gold Squadron,<ref name="XWOSG" /> Skywalker returned to Yavin Base for a [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] honoring the Rebel victory.<ref name="ANH" /> However, the victory came at a steep price for Red Squadron: while the squadron gained the distinction of being the unit that brought down the Death Star, it was nearly wiped out in the battle, with Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles as its only survivors.<ref name="TEGW" />

Shortly after the battle, Wedge Antilles, still flying as Red Two, was part of a Rebel force that discovered a [[Space Battle at Yavin 4|confrontation]] between a Rebel patrol, a small Imperial group, and the crime syndicate the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] in the remnants of the Death Star over Yavin 4. Vainly ordering the trespassing forces to surrender and submit to boarding, Antilles had the Rebel craft to regroup following heavy starfighter losses for another strike. As Imperial [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] forces arrived in-system, the Alliance was unable to prevent the Consortium from escaping with [[data pod]]s recovered from the Death Star.<ref name="EaWFoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

===Rogues and Renegades===
{{Main|Rogue Squadron/Legends|Renegade Flight}}

Following its decimation at the Battle of Yavin, Red Squadron was single-handedly rebuilt by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]],<ref name="RFF" />, a key member of the squadron prior to the destruction of the Death Star,<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> and reconstituted as a pair of flights. In addition to Red Squadron as a whole,<ref name="RFF" /> Narra led [[Renegade Flight]], while he tapped Luke Skywalker to lead [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]] with fellow survivor of Yavin Wedge Antilles as his second-in-command.<ref name="TEGW" />

The latter group carried out various operations, including [[Mission to Dantooine|aiding]] an [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Imperial officer]] in his defection into the Rebel Alliance and [[Defense of Ralltiir|rescuing]] Rebel-sympathizing scientists on Ralltiir after Imperial forces blockaded the planet.<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> As the Rogues became more autonomous, they became a group with no standing orders, ready any time or place for urgent missions that would arise. Renegade Flight was eventually destroyed before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], while escorting a convoy carrying supplies for the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].

===Mission to Kamino===
Some time after the Battle of Yavin, Commander Narra briefed Red Squadron pilots Skywalker, Antilles, and [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]] for a [[reconnaissance mission to Kamino]], investigating a now-abandoned Imperial research facility on the [[Kamino/Legends|planet]], said to have been developing a superweapon. Down several squadron members, Narra temporarily recruited the smugglers Han Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] into Red Squadron.<ref name="RFF" />

Given charge of the mission by Commander Narra, Red Leader Luke Skywalker led the squadron's five X-wings through hyperspace to Kamino's orbit, finding fluctuating gravitational readings, but no sign of the Empire. Overruling Red Two Han Solo and investigating the readings before landing, Skywalker was ambushed by four [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], hired by renegade Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] to kill him. Narrowly avoiding laserfire from a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-class starship]] flown by [[Lune Oddo Divinian]], Skywalker ordered his pilots to engage, unfolding their S-foils into attack position. Firing at a [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighter]], Solo's missile was intercepted by his target's antiballistic countermeasure, creating an explosion that seared the Rebel smuggler's X-wing and left him vulnerable to the ''Preybird''{{'s}} attack. With the enemy craft distracted by his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] partner Chewbacca, flying as Red Five, Solo recovered in time to shake the ''Preybird'' and target a pair of freighters tailing a trapped Luke Skywalker. Hurtling close enough to one of the freighters to make out the [[Grish B'reen|pilot's]] snout, Solo forced it out of formation before re-engaging with the ''Preybird''. With the mercenary starfighter on his tail, Solo pulled to starboard, overcompensating due to his experience with the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} temperamental thrusters, and landing in the firing path of the ''Firespray'', suffering only mild damage to his X-wing's aft engine thanks to the intervention of Luke Skywalker. With Red Squadron facing a lack of success despite outnumbering the enemy, Skywalker devised a new strategy: he, Solo, and Chewbacca would head for Kamino's surface while Wedge Antilles and Zev Senesca maintained their orbit, hoping to split the mercenary force in half. Instead, all four craft pursued Skywalker's ship, strafing him with laserfire. Attempting to reverse course, Skywalker found himself&mdash;along with Solo, Chewbacca, and the mercenaries&mdash;caught in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor field]], an old Imperial security measure and the source of the gravitational fluctuations. Drawn into the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Skywalker ejected from his fighter, [[Parachute/Legends|parachuting]] down to the [[Research City|city]] below. Unable to detect their squadron mates' life signs due to an atmospheric [[Electrical storm/Legends|electrical storm]], Antilles and Senesca returned to Yavin 4 to report the mission's failure.<ref name="RFF" />

Reunited with his allies, Skywalker rescued Han Solo from a group of native [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwhas]], and was engaged in a standoff with the grounded mercenaries when the opposing groups were attacked by a [[Kaminoan "super-weapon" project|large tentacled creature]], the genetically-manipulated product of the superweapon project and the cause of its abandonment. Cooperating to fend off the creature, the Rebels formed a truce with Lune Divinian, the lone surviving mercenary, and set off to disable the tractor field and locate transportation off Kamino, interrupted by the return of the "superweapon", swallowing Skywalker and Divinian whole. While the two killed the creature and attempted to escape its submerged lair in its air-tight stomach, Solo, Chewbacca, and R2-D2 discovered a number of spaceworthy ships&mdash;an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] and a pair of [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s&mdash;as well as [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] scientist [[Elo Panil]], one of the creatures' designers still overseeing his creations. Devising a plan to follow the creature back to its lair&mdash;and to Luke&mdash;via tracking device, Solo and the Wookiee mounted feral aiwhas and dove into the sea, rescuing Skywalker and Divinian just as they were set upon by a pack of "superweapon" creatures. Returning to the city, the group was fired upon by a group of amphibious Imperial assault [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] summoned by Panil, which they lured onto the sea, where the tanks were surrounded and overwhelmed by "superweapon" creatures. Now pursued by TIE fighters, Divinian and the Rebels fled to the research station's docking bay, meeting R2-D2 and escaping in their starfighters just as the station was destroyed.<ref name="RFF" />

With his Howlrunner's radar and communications disrupted by an electrical storm, Luke Skywalker struggled to engage the Imperial fighters while avoiding a collision. Following the path of a TIE's laserbolts through the cloud cover, Skywalker shot down the enemy ship. As another craft approached, Skywalker hesitated before firing, and realised that it was Divinian's Howlrunner. Surprised that the mercenary hadn't fired on him, Skywalker followed him out of the clouds, while the two worked in tandem to pick off three more TIE fighters. Pursued by a pair of TIEs and with its hyperdrive disabled, Han Solo and Chewbacca's ARC-170 dove into the streets of Research City, where a wild shot by the lead TIE struck the side of a building, taking out the Imperial's wingmate in a shower of [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]]. Drawing the remaining Imperial toward another duracrete building at high speed, Solo broke into a ninety-degree climb up its side, while the TIE veered around it, clearing the building but colliding with the levee behind it at the edge of the city, tearing a hole in the seawall and flooding the streets. With all planetary opposition defeated, the three starfighters left Kamino's atmosphere, but were met by four more TIE fighters in low orbit. Inverting his Howlrunner to get behind a pursuing TIE, Skywalker shot down his opponent, while the smugglers' ARC-170, engaged from behind by two TIE fighters, reversed direction with a hairpin swivel putting them face-to-face with the nearest TIE. Destroying the enemy ship, Solo guided the ARC away from its explosion only to see an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] drawing into range. With Skywalker focused on avoiding the Star Destroyer's turbolaser fire, a surviving TIE entered his blind spot. Despite his contract to kill the Rebel, Divinian launched a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] at the Imperial fighter, saving Skywalker's life while leading his own Howlrunner into the Star Destroyer's line of fire and disabling it. Lead by the ''Millennium Falcon'' flown by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], which destroyed the last TIE fighter, a strike team of eight X-wings, three Y-wings, and a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|blockade runner]] launched an assault on the Star Destroyer. Following a direct laser hit with a pair of proton torpedoes, the ''Falcon'' destroyed the ship's shield generator dome, while the X-wings fired on the now unshielded [[Hull/Legends|hull]], and Skywalker and Solo targeted the Star Destroyer's [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] in the hope of taking down its main reactor. As the Imperial ship fled into hyperspace, Skywalker, Solo, Chewbacca, and R2-D2 boarded the ''Millennium Falcon'' with Divinian as their prisoner, and returned to Yavin 4.<ref name="RFF" />

*Red Leader: Luke Skywalker
*Red Two: Han Solo
*Red Five: Chewbacca
*Wedge Antilles
*Zev Senesca

===Evacuation of Yavin===
Shortly before the [[evacuation of Yavin]] 4, [[0 ABY/Legends|six months after]] the Death Star's destruction,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Red Squadron&mdash;referred to as Red Squad&mdash;was shuttled up to [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Vors Voorhorian]]'s [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|derelict freighter]]<ref name="XWMTS">{{Kids1997Cite|issue1=6|issue2=10|story=X-Wing Marks the Spot}}</ref> to transport newly purchased X-wing starfighters to the Alliance base below.<ref name="IS">{{Kids1997Cite|issue1=11|issue2=15|story=Imperial Spy}}</ref>

Red Squadron escorted [[Chipr]], a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] owned by the Alliance, and [[Goat (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|Goat]], a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]], to carry troops and workers away from Yavin 4.

===Aboard the ''Defiance''===
Following the Battle of Hoth, a Red Group of four X-wing starfighters [[Battle of Hospital|defended]] Alliance evacuation ships ferrying personnel from a [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|secret Rebel hospital]] under attack by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']] and its [[Corrupter Task Force|task force]]. [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] present for that battle, later enlisted as a Rebel pilot and flew with Red Group's X-wings while based on the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']].<ref name="XWA" /> Azzameen and three other Red Group X-wing pilots provided cover for a [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|raid]] on an [[Veltnor|Imperial convoy]], destroying all twelve of the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] [[Scythe (Strike-class)|''Scythe'']]{{'s}} [[Alpha Squadron|complement]] of TIE fighters, and for the [[Rescue at Bundil II|rescue]] of Rebel [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from the Imperial [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[VTR-LX]]''.<ref name="XWASG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Another four&ndash;X-wing Red Group defended the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]] of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Group]]&mdash;to which Azzameen had been assigned&mdash;as they [[Battle of Bettel|eliminated]] the [[Corrupter repair convoy|team]] tasked with the repair of the damaged ''Corrupter''. Azzameen returned to Red Group, in an element of six X-wings, for a [[Battle of the Anoat Main Sensor Array|mission to disable the defenses]] of the Imperial [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] [[IOS 24]].<ref name="XWA" />

===Aboard the ''Liberty''===
''Defiance'' flight staff, including Red Group pilots, were transferred to the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] during its investigation of the Empire's [[TIE Experimental Project]]. Azzameen's four&ndash;X-wing formation of Red Group protected the boarding team [[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]] as they [[Battle of Nomlis III|raided]] a [[Bretie Facility|production facility]] for data on the prototype TIEs,<ref name="XWA" /> and he joined eight of the group's other X-wing pilots in [[Defense of the Liberty|defense of the ''Liberty'']] from a retaliatory attack by the experimental craft. Finally, Red Group took part in an [[Battle of Obsidian|all-out assault]] on the [[XQ1 Platform]] [[Obsidian (XQ1 Platform)|''Obsidian'']], the project's main research and production facility. Though the group lost an X-wing in the battle, ''Obsidian'' was destroyed and the experimental TIE threat was ended.<ref name="XWASG" />

Azzameen and Red Group employed four Y-wings in [[Mission to liberate KDT Group|investigating]] the coordinates of a reported [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] convoy. Scanning the Imperial [[KDT Group]] of [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|Sentinel-class landing craft]],<ref name="XWA" /> Azzameen identified five as carrying slaves and disabled them for boarding by the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] of [[Tango Group]], before engaging their [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] escorts, of which he destroyed seven. One Y-wing was destroyed prior to the extraction's completion and the Rebel force's return to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWASG" />

===Raid on Golrath Station===
Stationed at the Alliance's [[Haven Base]] on the planet [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]], Red Squadron was joined by Blue Squadron for an [[Raid on Golrath Station|expedition]] to an [[Golrath Station|abandoned Rebel base]] on [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]] to destroy records of their activities contained within the rock of the base's walls. The two squadrons of X-wing and Y-wing starfighters conducted a diversionary raid against the occupying Imperial forces, while Princess Leia Organa attempted to infiltrate the station and sabotage the reactor. Although Leia Organa was intercepted by Imperial Lieutenant [[Mils Giel]], Giel himself overloaded the reactor in an attempt to kill her, while Organa was able to escape aboard a Y-wing flown by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. With the data destroyed, the squadrons returned to Arbra, save for Luke Skywalker, whose X-wing's hyperdrive had been disabled by a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] shot from Lieutenant Giel.<ref name="SW65">[[Star Wars (1977) 65|''Star Wars'' (1977) 65]]</ref>

===Battle of Endor===
[[File:RedGroup.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Red Squadron recruitment poster]]
For the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Wedge Antilles changed the name of Rogue Squadron to Red Squadron, with himself as Red Leader, to honor the heroes of Yavin.<ref name="TCSWE" />

*Red Leader: Wedge Antilles<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />
*Red Two: a [[Red Two (Battle of Endor)|Human male]]<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />
*Red Three: [[Sila Kott/Legends|Sila Kott]]<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

===After Endor===
By the time of the [[Bakura Incident]], the group had returned to the Rogue Squadron name,<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> although the Rogues once again adopted "Red" [[Callsign/Legends|call signs]] during a [[Battle of Tandankin|strike]] at [[Tandankin]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Special">''[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron Special]]''</ref>

Two days after the Battle of Endor, another Red Squadron, likewise referred to as Red Group, had formed, flying X-wings alongside Wedge Antilles' Rogues as part of the [[Bakura task force]] dispatched to repel the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium|Ssi-ruuvi]] [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] of the Imperial-held [[Bakura/Legends|planet]], hoping to win Bakura's loyalty for the Alliance. Arriving to find the Imperial defenders outgunned by the Ssi-ruuk, the task force's offer of aid was accepted by Imperial Commander [[Pter Thanas]]. While Rogue and Gold Squadrons engaged a [[Wurrif-class light cruiser|Ssi-ruuvi light cruiser]], Red Squadron was split into two groups: Red One through Four would maintain an escape vector for the attacking squadrons, while Red Five and the rest of Red Squadron held formation with Commander Luke Skywalker's flagship the ''[[Flurry]]''. During the battle, Skywalker deployed Red Five's group to clear Antilles' tail of pursuing [[Swarm-class battle droid|battle droids]], leaving the ''Flurry'' vulnerable to enemy craft and forcing Skywalker to request assistance from all Alliance squadrons before the timely arrival of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Spotting an opening for attack, Commander Skywalker had Red Squadron approach the light cruiser, coming across its bow from beneath as it turned. Blind to the squadron's fighters, the Ssi-ruuvi cruiser was destroyed by Red Leader.<ref name="TAB" />

With the Ssi-ruuvi forces temporarily in retreat and the Alliance squadrons resting and refueling aboard the ''Flurry'', Leia Organa negotiated a [[Bakura Truce|truce]] with the Bakuran Imperial government, adding Rebel ships to the planet's defense web. Betraying the Alliance, Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] captured Luke Skywalker and turned him over to the Ssi-ruuk in exchange for their withdrawal from Bakura, though Nereus had covertly infected Skywalker with [[Olabrian trichoid]] parasites in the hopes of wiping out his captors. Directing attention away from the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] carrying the captive Skywalker to the Ssi-ruuvi flagship the [[Sibwarra|''Shriwirr'']], the invaders launched an [[Battle of Bakura|attack]] on the allied Rebel and Imperial forces. As the defenders attempted to close an arc around two Ssi-ruuvi [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], Commander Thanas directed the ''Millennium Falcon''&mdash;flanked by four of Red Group's X-wings and five TIE fighters&mdash;to fill a gap in the formation left as the Imperial's damaged [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] the ''[[Dominant]]'' drifted low and to starboard. An hour later, as the defeated Ssi-ruuvi craft&mdash;save the ''Shriwirr'', commandeered by Luke Skywalker, and its escort of [[Fw'Sen-class picket ship|picket ships]]&mdash;prepared a final retreat, General Han Solo ordered the Alliance squadron leaders to get clear of the Imperial starfighters, anticipating the end of the truce. One thousand kilometers from the ''Falcon'' and surrounded by TIE fighters, Red Squadron engaged their erstwhile allies in a dogfight, attempting to form up on Solo's freighter. Suffering heavy losses, the remaining Rebel starfighters formed a loose double squadron surrounded by a globe of Imperial fighters and [[IR-3F-class light frigate/Legends|patrol craft]], while the ''Dominant'', ordered to destroy the ''Shriwirr'' with Skywalker on board, drifted toward the Ssi-ruuvi cruiser. As the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} crew prepared to sacrifice themselves in a [[carom shot]] to save Skywalker and the remainder of the task force, Red Group formed up on the freighter and made for a gap in the Imperial blockade. While the ''Falcon'' failed to prevent the ''Dominant'' from firing on the ''Shriwirr'', Skywalker survived, and was recovered by the freighter's crew. Ordering the Alliance forces to cease firing on the ''Dominant'', Skywalker convinced Thanas to stand down. With the Ssi-ruuk repulsed, the Imperial forces offering their surrender, and the people of Bakura voting to join the Rebel Alliance, the survivors of the Bakura task force returned to Endor.<ref name="TAB" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] a Red Squadron joined [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue]] and "[[Medpac Squadron]]"<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> under the ''Millennium Falcon'' as a defense group for ''[[New Hope]]'' during the [[battle in the Milagro system]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization of ''A New Hope'']], Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles flew for Blue Squadron. Their squadron was changed to Red Squadron when it was realized that blue markings on the ships would be replaced by moving starfield during bluescreen shots. Consequently, the name of the fighter group the novelization called Red Squadron was changed to Gold Squadron for the film.

The comic adaptation indicated that Red Squadron ("Blue Group") contained only six pilots, but subsequent literature changed the number to twelve. The comic adaptation also established that Luke was the youngest member of the squadron at the Battle of Yavin. The comic differs from the film in showing one of Red Leader's wingmen during the trench run piloting a Y-wing.

Red Squadron was also a recurring starfighter squadron in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. However, as all Alliance starfighter squadrons in the game are merely named by colors, this designation may have been an in-mission callsign system, rather than actual squadron names. This explanation is in line with most military procedures of assigning short callsigns for operational use.

Actor [[John Chapman]] claims that his character, "Gil Viray," was Red Twelve,<ref name="Red 12">{{WebCite|url=http://www.red12.org|text=Red 12|work=Official Website of John Chapman|archivedate=20080129123539}}</ref> but the claim was unverified until it was revealed that the character Puck Naeco flew under the callsign at Yavin.

The [[1998]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'' identifies [[Gayla Riemann]] as a Rogue Squadron veteran, and ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'' claims that she flew an X-wing during the Battle of Endor. No source has revealed whether she flew with Red Squadron in the battle.
